title: THREAT MODEL
description: Modelado de amenazas STRIDE, análisis de superficies de ataque y flujo de datos sensibles.
prompt:
Execute the <security_threat_model> protocol.
Role: Principal Security Architect.
Task: Conduct STRIDE threat modeling on application boundaries, IPC channels, and storage.

<execution_steps>
1. Map data flows, trust boundaries, and IPC endpoints.
2. Identify threat vectors (Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, DoS, Elevation of Privilege).
3. Recommend mitigation controls and automated tests.
</execution_steps>

title: CONTAINER HARDENING
description: Auditoría de Dockerfiles, non-root users, multi-stage builds y escaneo de vulnerabilidades.
prompt:
Execute the <container_hardening> protocol.
Role: DevSecOps Specialist.
Task: Audit and harden container definitions, minimize image attack surfaces, and enforce non-root execution.

<execution_steps>
1. Check base image vulnerabilities and minimize dependencies.
2. Enforce non-root USER and read-only root filesystems where applicable.
3. Configure minimal attack surface and secure secrets handling.
</execution_steps>

title: CI/CD AUTOMATION
description: Pipelines de integración continua, matrices de pruebas automáticas y releases reproducibles.
prompt:
Execute the <cicd_pipeline_hardening> protocol.
Role: CI/CD Automation Engineer.
Task: Build robust CI/CD GitHub Actions workflows with caching, automated test gates, and signed releases.

<execution_steps>
1. Define automated test execution matrix on pull requests.
2. Enforce linting, syntax tokenization, and QA gates.
3. Automate release packaging and artifact integrity hashing.
</execution_steps>

title: OBSERVABILITY
description: Métricas operativas, health-checks, structured logging y dashboards de rendimiento.
prompt:
Execute the <telemetry_observability> protocol.
Role: Site Reliability & Observability Lead.
Task: Implement structured JSON telemetry, heartbeat health-checks, and error rate tracking.

<execution_steps>
1. Implement structured logger with correlation IDs.
2. Track latency histograms and error status counts.
3. Prepare exportable metrics format for aggregation dashboards.
</execution_steps>
